items.stem: Why are shared drives preferred over My Drive for team-owned project files?

options.text: Files are owned by the team, so access survives member departures
options.rationale: Correct: shared-drive content is team-owned and persists when individuals leave.

options.text: They use a completely different internet
options.rationale: That is not how storage works.
Shared drives still support controlled sharing.

items.stem: Which TWO actions reduce the risk of over-sharing in Drive? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use restricted link sharing with named people for confidential files
Periodically audit and tighten existing link permissions
options.rationale: Correct: access reviews catch over-shared files.

options.text: Set everything to anyone-with-the-link by default
Assume unlisted files are automatically private

items.explanation: Correct: restricted sharing and periodic access audits both reduce over-sharing.
